description: One entity's own thresholds, where the shipped ones are wrong for it. OAR 437-004-1131 sets a floor and not a ceiling: a camp crew working in full PPE, a variety picked in September under black shade cloth, or an operation whose insurer asked for a lower trigger are all reasons to engage earlier than 80 °F, and an operator who cannot express that either runs the whole site at the wrong number or turns the alerting off. EVERY FIELD IS NULLABLE AND NULL MEANS THE PARENT — a row that exists to lower the wind limit must not silently reset the heat limit to zero, which is what a non-null default on the other two columns would do.

fields.description: The entity these thresholds belong to. One row per company — a second row for the same company is refused, because two answers to 'what is this company's heat threshold' is one answer nobody can defend under audit.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Air temperature this entity's Threshold Crossed events fire at. EMPTY FALLS BACK TO THE PARENT — it is not zero, and a blank here means 'this company has no opinion about air temperature' rather than 'every reading crosses'.
fields.label: Heat Threshold — Temp (°F)

fields.description: Heat index this entity's Threshold Crossed events fire at. The number the rule actually turns on. Empty falls back to the parent.
fields.label: Heat Threshold — Heat Index (°F)

fields.description: Wind speed at which a Spray shift on this entity gets a Threshold Crossed event. Pesticide labels differ by product and an operation spraying a drift-restricted material near a school buffer has a lower number than the WPS default. Empty falls back to the parent.
fields.label: Wind Threshold — Spray Block (mph)

name: Weather Company Override
